comparator_baseline.name: CO2 molecular-weight negative control against water target
comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: Use each row's pre-declared comparator_prediction against the same withheld target; aggregate by mean absolute residual.

uncertainty.method: Target-blind row declared uncertainty; interval upper bound is max(row uncertainty, aggregate model residual). Pack remains blocked unless N and grand-scope predicates pass.

negative_controls.description: replace H2O by CO2 and require larger residual

falsifiers: Residual exceeds declared uncertainty or CO2 control is not worse than formula reconstruction
